cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Oh, hi.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I saw your advertisement about copying pictures to disk and I'd like a bit more

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: information about what you do.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Well, I've got a box full of old family photos that's been up in the attic for years,

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: some of them must be 50 or 60 years old, and I'd like to get them converted to digital

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: format.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: Right. And what about size?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: The photos are all sorts of sizes – are there any restrictions?

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Well the maximum size of photo we can do with our normal services is 30 centimetres.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: And each picture must be a least 4 centimetres, that's the minimum we can cope with.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That should be fine.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: And some of them are in a frame – should I take them out before I send them?

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Yes please, we can't copy them otherwise.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: And also the photos must all be separate, they mustn't be stuck into an album.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: OK, that's not a problem. So can you give me an idea of how much this will cost?

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: I've got about 360 photos I think.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: We charge £195 for 300 to 400 photos for the basic service.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Yes, one disk – but you can get extra ones for £5 each.

cues.speaker: AN
cues.text: That's good. So do I need to pay when I send you the photos?

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: No, we won't need anything until we've actually copied the pictures.

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: Then we'll let you know how much it is, and once we've received the payment, we'll send

cues.speaker: EE
cues.text: the parcel off to you.
